item.title: 50 years of Reggae in the Fields
item.description: What began as a 30-minute experiment in 1976 has grown into Canada’s longest-running reggae radio show and a cultural mainstay on Ottawa’s airwaves. For five decades, Reggae in the Fields has shared Jamaican music, political dialogue and Black cultural expression with CKCU listeners.
